Product Details

With our powder formula, you’re getting pure hydrolyzed bovine Collagen, nothing else. Its neutral flavor profile mixes perfectly into food and drink. And it’s an optimal form for absorption.

Learn More

Our bodies’ natural production of Collagen starts to slow in our later teens to early twenties, and it is further impacted by stress, sun exposure, and other lifestyle factors. Most of us are not getting enough of the amino acids glycine and proline that are found readily in Collagen through other protein sources in our diet. Our Collagen Protein optimally supports women’s health including: blood sugar balance, satiety, joint health, bone density, pelvic floor health, skin and hair health, gut health, immune function, heart health, and more*. At all stages of womanhood, our Collagen Protein is an optimal addition to your daily routine.

How to Use

Mix one (1) scoop into a single serving of food or drink throughout the day as needed. Store fully sealed in a cool dry place.

Questions? We have answers.

Thoughtful inquiry is needed.

Our Collagen Protein is derived from bovine collagen, so it is not vegan or vegetarian. It is also made without GMOs, artificial colors, artificial flavors, and other additives.

Yes. While our Collagen Protein was designed to support women before, during, and after pregnancy, it can be beneficial at any stage of life. Our Collagen Protein provides key amino acids that help support blood sugar balance, satiety, joint health, bone density, pelvic floor health, skin and hair health, gut health, immune function, heart health, and more.* Whether you’re preparing for pregnancy, navigating the reproductive years, or simply prioritizing long-term health, our Collagen Protein can be a supportive addition to your routine.

Our Collagen Protein is easy to incorporate into your daily routine. It can be blended into smoothies, stirred into yogurt or oatmeal, added to warm or cool beverages, or even used in baking. For the smoothest mix, we recommend using an electric frother when adding it to drinks. If you’re looking for inspiration, you can explore more ideas on The Motherspan™ and in our Getting Started Guide.

Collagen is an incomplete protein that includes a combination of essential and non-essential amino acids, including glycine, hydroxyproline, arginine, and leucine. It lacks tryptophan, an essential amino acid. To support tryptophan intake, incorporate foods such as chicken breast, eggs, cheese (cheddar & parmesan), salmon, soybeans & tofu, pumpkin seeds, and nuts. It's suggested to consume collagen alongside a variety of proteins to support overall protein intake.
